facts.fact: Minister Raliou Sidi Mohamed, opening a workshop on 11 March 2025, said the Autorité de Certification Electronique (ANCE) was created by law, which participants were to learn about alongside trust service providers and e-signature certification.
The president of Niger's Haute Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel (HAPDP) attended the workshop opening on 11 March 2025.
The minister listed a law on personal data protection adopted on 16 December 2022 among Niger's legal texts.
The minister said Niger's Law 2019-03 of 30 April 2019 on electronic transactions has an implementing decree, no. 2024-715 of 15 November 2024.
Implementing decree no. 2024-715 of 15 November 2024 was taken under the electronic transactions law, per the minister.
